data.description:
## Summary
plugins/dso/scripts/check-skill-refs.sh line 27 sets
  REPO_ROOT=\"\$(cd \"\$SCRIPT_DIR/..\" && pwd)\"

When invoked on a host project via the shim (.claude/scripts/dso check-skill-refs.sh), \$SCRIPT_DIR is the plugin-cache scripts dir, so REPO_ROOT resolves to the plugin root (~/.claude/plugins/.../dso-dev/<ver>/), NOT the host repo. The script's CLAUDE.md skill-ref check at ~line 106 then silently inspects the plugin's CLAUDE.md instead of the host's. Result: host operators get a silent PASS even when their CLAUDE.md has unqualified /skill references that should be flagged.

## Reproduction
1. Install DSO plugin on a host project via marketplace.
2. Add an unqualified \`/skill xyz\` reference to host CLAUDE.md.
3. Run \`.claude/scripts/dso check-skill-refs.sh\`.
4. Observe: exits 0 (silent pass). Expected: non-zero exit citing the host reference.

## Fix
Replace line 27 with:
  REPO_ROOT=\"\${PROJECT_ROOT:-\$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}\"
Add a hard-error if REPO_ROOT is empty.

This mirrors check-rule-anchors.sh:48 and audit-skill-resolution.sh:25 (already host-portable).

## Discovered by
Opus audit subagent on 2026-05-28 during PR-4 host-portability review.
Reference: similar fix shipped in PR #442 for provision-ruleset.sh DEFAULT_BRANCH resolution.
data.title: check-skill-refs.sh REPO_ROOT resolves to plugin cache on host project
